title: Outside view
subtitle: trailing KPIs, what a customer or an investor would see

kpis.label: Profit per tonne at the landfill price
kpis.definition: Per tonne received: the customer's landfill tipping fee + bale sales at the grade actually achieved - the all-in processing cost (labour, energy, maintenance, overhead, capital) - outlet and residue fees. The fee is pinned to the customer's own landfill rate, so charging more cannot raise it.
kpis.record: weigh-scale tickets (t in), bale invoices at the grade sold, the cost ledger, and which landfill tariff class the customer pays

kpis.label: Tonnes diverted at grade
kpis.note: No BAM site is deployed yet, so this is a known 0, not a reading.
kpis.definition: Tonnes leaving in bales a buyer accepts (sold or downgraded), per week.
kpis.record: weigh-scale tickets of accepted bales per site

kpis.label: Diverted share at BAM sites
kpis.definition: The share of tonnes received that leaves in accepted bales. A facility's yield: not ECCC's jurisdiction diversion rate, so it never shares the provinces' colour scale.
kpis.record: per site and month: t received, t leaving in accepted bales, t to disposal

kpis.label: Bale purity, worst bin

target.label: each bin at its grade floor (95% paper, film)

kpis.definition: Purity by mass of the dirtiest bin carrying at least 1% of output, against its ReMA grade floor.
kpis.record: bale audits, or a camera QC check per bale

kpis.label: Processing cost per tonne, all-in

target.label: below the landfill rate it competes with

kpis.definition: Labour, energy, maintenance, overhead and capital recovery per tonne received; always read beside throughput (no tonnes, no cost).
kpis.record: the cost ledger divided by weigh-scale tonnes

kpis.label: Output categories at grade
kpis.definition: Distinct output streams that meet a sellable grade (not bins installed).
kpis.record: bale grades per stream from the buyers' acceptance

kpis.label: Default alive
kpis.definition: Paul Graham's test: on today's cash, costs held flat and revenue growing at its recent rate, does the company reach profitability?
kpis.record: revenue growth and burn from the monthly exports

foot: Committed public version: definitions and what to record only. BAM's modelled values live in a local overlay (fixtures/local), never in this public repo.
